d:
"Carnivorous shapeshifters, mad doctors, creepy unicorns, “reformed” pirates, amorous squid, cultist psychiatrists and all kinds of wacky aliens abound in this reboot! Anthronauts: Alternate Universe lacks most of the traumatic and world-ending elements from the original, focusing on dark and zany humor." - Artist

Comic started on July 2013 and discontinued on March 2016.
